items.title: An explicit three-player NOF exactly-N protocol with improved leading communication constant
items.author: Nati Linial; Adi Shraibman
items.source_version: Official complete 8-page CCC2021 publication; Theorem1 and entire Section2 author proof; Section3 direct corner-free consequence retained as context.
items.difficulty_reason: The author protocol uses shared input to encode base-q carry information by conditional entropy, couples that encoding to a squared-distance vector-addition test, and converts typical-case correctness to all inputs via a fractional-cover translation argument.

primary.label: Official NOF model, base-2 conventions and Theorem1

proof_spans.label: Complete official Section2 protocols, carry entropy and Proposition2 proof

contexts.label: Direct corner-free consequence and original implicit Claim4, uncounted
